about_the_game:
Gun Trader: The Town's Gunsmith

You're running a gun shop in a small town, dealing with dozens of customers every day. Stock the shelves, watch the prices, and buy low-sell high to turn a profit. But be careful — not every customer is innocent.

📦 Display your weapons, keep your customers happy, and enjoy the cash flow.
🧹 Keep your shop clean — trash will scare customers away.
💬 Interact with the townspeople — weird and funny dialogues await.
⚠️ Threats and dangers can appear at any moment. Stay alert.

It may seem simple, but every detail matters.
It’s your shop, your rules — but staying in business won’t be easy.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains content intended for mature audiences.

The gameplay involves trading and displaying realistic firearms. Blood effects are present, and certain scenes may include depictions of violence. Some in-game locations feature strip clubs and include visual representations of strippers. The player character can consume alcohol and smoke cigarettes.

These elements are designed to reflect the dark and underground atmosphere of the game’s world. The game does not contain sexual acts, non-consensual content, or self-harm scenes.

short_description: Gun Trader is a quirky shop sim where you run a gun store in a strange little town. Stock shelves, deal with odd customers, clean your store, and watch out—some visitors aren’t so friendly. Trade smart, survive chaos, and build your own rules.
